task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement zero-noise extrapolation by hand in Qiskit: estimate <ZZ> of a Bell circuit under depolarizing noise (p=0.055 on CX), amplify noise via global unitary folding (factors 1, 3, 5), fit a linear extrapolation to zero noise, and compare with the ideal value 1.0. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
